name: kda_decode_recurrent_d128_h16_bf16
description: Recurrent Kimi Delta Attention decode with the flashinfer.kda_decode.recurrent_kda contract (flashinfer PR #4279): bf16 D=128 q/k/v, log-space or raw per-key-channel gate, pre-sigmoided beta, in-kernel q/k L2 norm, GVA (HV % H == 0), and a v-first bf16 state pool. T=1 rows use the standard [N, 1, ...] decode layout; T>=2 rows use packed speculative decode ([1, N*T, ...] with cu_seqlens, per-token checkpoint slots via ssm_state_indices and num_accepted_tokens); T=3 rows use the lower-bound gate (raw g with fp32 A_log/dt_bias, lower_bound=-5). The returned state pool is a new tensor holding the written checkpoints. Workloads are the PR's 30-row matrix: five sequence counts per token count.

token_batch.description: Leading q/k/v dim: N for standard decode, 1 for packed spec decode.

token_len.description: Second q/k/v dim: 1 for standard decode, N*T for packed spec decode.

num_state_slots.description: State pool slots: N for standard decode, N*T + 6 for spec decode.

cu_seqlens_len.description: N + 1 for spec decode, 0 (absent) for standard decode.

lower_bound_gate.description: 1 on lower-bound gate rows (raw g, A_log, dt_bias), else 0.

constraints: num_tokens == 1 implies cu_seqlens, ssm_state_indices, num_spec_tokens, num_accepted_tokens are None
lower_bound_gate == 0 implies A_log, dt_bias, lower_bound are None
q.dtype == k.dtype == v.dtype == g.dtype == beta.dtype == initial_state.dtype == torch.bfloat16

g.description: Per-key-channel gate: log-space on precomputed rows, raw on lower-bound rows.

A_log.description: Log decay per head; None on precomputed rows.

dt_bias.description: Gate bias per head and key channel; None on precomputed rows.

initial_state.description: V-first state pool [slots, HV, V, K]; not modified by the call.

ssm_state_indices.description: Checkpoint slot per sequence and token (spec decode only).

num_accepted_tokens.description: Accepted tokens of the previous round; the start slot is ssm_state_indices[n, accepted - 1] (spec decode only).

lower_bound.description: Negative gate lower bound (lower-bound rows only).

final_state.description: New state pool: written checkpoint slots, all other slots equal to initial_state.

reference:
import torch


@torch.no_grad()
def run(
    q: torch.Tensor,
    k: torch.Tensor,
    v: torch.Tensor,
    g: torch.Tensor,
    beta: torch.Tensor,
    A_log,
    dt_bias,
    scale: float,
    initial_state: torch.Tensor,
    cu_seqlens,
    ssm_state_indices,
    num_spec_tokens,
    num_accepted_tokens,
    lower_bound,
):
    """
    Recurrent KDA decode (flashinfer.kda_decode.recurrent_kda semantics) in
    fp32, one sequence and one token at a time:

    • q/k are L2-normalized along the head dimension in-kernel, q scaled by
      ``scale``; value head hv uses q/k head hv // (HV // H) (GVA).
    • gate: precomputed rows pass log-space g (decay = exp(g)); lower-bound
      rows pass raw g with fp32 A_log[H] / dt_bias[H*K] and
      decay = exp(lower_bound * sigmoid(exp(A_log) * (g + dt_bias))).
    • per token, with S the [K, V] state of one value head:
          S = S * decay[:, None]; S += beta * outer(k, v - k @ S); o = q @ S
    • standard decode (cu_seqlens is None): q [N, 1, H, K]; sequence n reads
      and writes state slot n.
    • speculative decode: packed q [1, N*T, H, K] with T = 1 + num_spec_tokens
      tokens per sequence (cu_seqlens); sequence n starts from slot
      ssm_state_indices[n, num_accepted_tokens[n] - 1] and writes the state
      after token t to slot ssm_state_indices[n, t]; other slots are untouched.
    • the state pool is v-first bf16 [slots, HV, V, K]; the returned pool is a
      new tensor (the input pool is not modified).
    """

    num_qk_heads, head_dim = q.shape[-2], q.shape[-1]
    num_v_heads = v.shape[-2]
    group = num_v_heads // num_qk_heads
    standard = cu_seqlens is None
    if standard:
        num_seqs, num_tokens = q.shape[0], 1
    else:
        num_seqs = int(cu_seqlens.numel()) - 1
        num_tokens = int(num_spec_tokens) + 1

    def normalize(x):
        return x * torch.rsqrt(x.square().sum(-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6)

    qf = normalize(q.float()).reshape(num_seqs, num_tokens, num_qk_heads, head_dim) * float(scale)
    kf = normalize(k.float()).reshape(num_seqs, num_tokens, num_qk_heads, head_dim)
    vf = v.float().reshape(num_seqs, num_tokens, num_v_heads, head_dim)
    bf = beta.float().reshape(num_seqs, num_tokens, num_v_heads)
    gf = g.float().reshape(num_seqs, num_tokens, num_v_heads, head_dim)
    if A_log is not None:
        head_of_v = torch.arange(num_v_heads, device=q.device) // group
        a = A_log.float().exp()[head_of_v]  # [HV]
        bias = dt_bias.float().view(num_qk_heads, head_dim)[head_of_v]  # [HV, K]
        gf = float(lower_bound) * torch.sigmoid(a[:, None] * (gf + bias))
    decay = gf.exp()

    output = torch.empty_like(v, dtype=torch.float32)
    output_view = output.reshape(num_seqs, num_tokens, num_v_heads, head_dim)
    pool = initial_state.clone()
    if not standard:
        indices = ssm_state_indices.to(torch.int64).cpu()
        accepted = (
            torch.ones(num_seqs, dtype=torch.int64)
            if num_accepted_tokens is None
            else num_accepted_tokens.to(torch.int64).cpu().clamp(1, num_tokens)
        )
    for n in range(num_seqs):
        if standard:
            start_slot = n
        else:
            start_slot = int(indices[n, accepted[n] - 1])
        # k-first fp32 working state [HV, K, V] from the v-first bf16 slot.
        S = pool[start_slot].float().transpose(-1, -2).clone()
        for t in range(num_tokens):
            q_t = qf[n, t].repeat_interleave(group, dim=0)  # [HV, K]
            k_t = kf[n, t].repeat_interleave(group, dim=0)
            v_t, b_t = vf[n, t], bf[n, t]
            S = S * decay[n, t][:, :, None]
            kS = torch.einsum("hk,hkv->hv", k_t, S)
            S = S + torch.einsum("hk,hv->hkv", b_t[:, None] * k_t, v_t - kS)
            output_view[n, t] = torch.einsum("hk,hkv->hv", q_t, S)
            slot = n if standard else int(indices[n, t])
            pool[slot] = S.transpose(-1, -2).to(pool.dtype)
    return output.to(v.dtype), pool
